paragraphs.text: The scorecard's gaps generate the work (check: cmd/loop TestScorecardGapsBecomeProposals, cmd/loop TestTheGapsAreFiledOnceTheScorecardPublishes, cmd/loop TestADeclineBecomesTheRowTheLoopWorks). Progress is each scorecard cell against its previous measurement, not a count of landings (check: internal/scorecard TestEarlierIsEachCellsNewestEarlierMeasurement, cmd/loop TestCycleComparesWithTheNewestEarlierScorecardWithoutAMain). There is no passed state (check: cmd/gate TestCompletionAuthorityGone, internal/plan TestLivePlanRejectsRetainedCompletionState).

One run serves every obligation whose identity and contract match, written once as one record with many readers (check: cmd/loop TestMeasurementRunsNoCaseAgainAfterAnUnrelatedCommit, internal/evaluation TestEvaluationAtAnUnchangedPlanReusesItsCampaign, internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity). A run never judges what it produced (check: internal/runrecord TestProposerEvaluatorDeciderAuthorityDomainsAndPriorGeneration, internal/trainingworkflow TestHeldoutRunTrainsOnlyOnTrainingRecords, internal/runrecord TestTrainingDecisionWithholdsPromotionUntilEvaluation). Every contract a comparison reads and every retained protocol is a cell the cycle runs (check: cmd/validate TestEveryComparedContractHasACell, cmd/validate TestCycleRunsWhatPromotionCompares).

The gate's verdict depends only on the tree, and suites that load real models, read the live store or sweep the device run in the cycle's lanes by build tag, never the gate's (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/landing TestLaneSelectionUsesTheLaneBuildContext, internal/landing TestAudioLaneOptsIntoTheStoreAcceptance). The cycle measures at the commit it began at, in its own checkout (check: cmd/loop TestCycleRunsInItsOwnCheckout). A landing's cost is read from its diff, the lanes it reaches through its test binaries' closure and the pinned media it stales (check: internal/landing TestLaneReachSkipsOtherPackagesTests, internal/landing TestPreflightNamesPinnedBytes). A move of a model's own identity puts its cases again (check: internal/evaluation TestAnswersOutliveOnlyTheCommitsThatLeaveTheirCodeUnchanged, internal/inferencesurface TestEvaluationIdentityIsItsModelsWithTheSourcesThatAskIt). A cycle starts once the measured surface moved (check: cmd/loop TestLoopStartsACycleWhenTheMeasuredSurfaceMoved). Dependency work is verified through its test closure and the guard surface, which stops at overgodb and runrecord (check: internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceCoversEmbeddedInputsAndModules, internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceInvariants). A suite moved out of the gate still reaches a cycle lane (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/trainingworkflow TestEveryRetiredLifecycleFailureIsStillCaught). The landing scorecard reports and never refuses (check: internal/landing TestLandingMeasuresTheScorecardSlice). The gate writes the numbers a landing message carries (check: internal/landing TestLanesMeasurementLine, internal/landing TestLandingSaysWhatAChangeAddsOfEachKind).

Before a landing the preflight runs the cheap stages alone, format, fix, vet, rules, invariants and the step's check (check: internal/landing TestPreflightRunsTheCheapStagesOnly, internal/landing TestGeneratorsAreThoseTheRepositoryHas).

Each structural boundary is pinned as a row of its kind's invariant table (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceInvariants). The gate writes each landing's lanes skipped, lane walls, and packages executed and cached (check: internal/landing TestLanesMeasurementLine, internal/landing TestRanPackagesNamesOnlyWhatRan). No fixed timer comes back, nor the deleted baselines and tracking records (check: internal/repoanalysis TestNoFixedTimers, cmd/gate TestClosureLedgerGone, cmd/gate TestGateRecordsGone).

A journey is timed from action to usable result, with loading, waiting, execution and display apart (check: cmd/recipe TestMeasurementSeparatesLoadPrefillAndVisibleOutput, internal/server TestWebUIBrowserShowsTheFirstTokenTime, internal/server TestCancelledDownloadHoldsItsSlotUntilItFinishes). One gate run serves every step it lands (check: internal/landing TestLandingCompletesSeveralSteps). Validation and reuse are scoped by actual dependencies, and one that cannot be named keeps the wider scope (check: internal/inferencesurface TestCapabilityIdentityMovesOnlyWithItsOwnSources, internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity, cmd/validate TestBenchmarkDoesNotReuseUnknownExecution).

A full measurement run continues only at the commit it began at (check: cmd/loop TestUnfinishedCycleContinuesAtItsOwnCommit, cmd/loop TestInterruptedCycleResumesAtItsFirstUnpassedPhase). Landings go on beside a run, waiting only for the device turn, with the checkout free (check: internal/landing TestALandingBesideARunWaitsOnlyForTheDevice, internal/landing TestALandingWaitingOnARunLeavesTheCheckoutFree).

The repository tracks no Python, and its runtime is Go (check: internal/repoanalysis TestPythonLivesOnlyInItsIgnoredPlace, internal/repoanalysis TestRSIRuntimeIsGoOnly). A row's acceptance is fixed before its code, every open step having a check and a change judged by the check its row held before it (check: internal/plan TestOpenStepRequiresVerifier, internal/landing TestChangeIsJudgedByTheTermsItStartedWith). A reader of a record form the store holds stays while the store holds it (check: internal/runrecord TestStageReceiptOfTheEarlierFormIsRead, internal/runrecord TestRetiredGateAliasesAtRest). A pilot not accepted leaves the served path, and its record is kept (check: cmd/train TestPilotKeepsItsRecordBeforeItRemovesItsCheckpoints, internal/trainingworkflow TestRewardAdoptionRequiresDeclaredComparisons, cmd/train TestProposalRetirementPreservesTrainingAndEvidence).

A change grows production code no more than its row's count, read from the commit it builds on, so a consolidation pays for what it adds with what it deletes, and an item's count covers all its landings (check: internal/landing TestItemsGrowthIsChargedAcrossItsLandings, internal/landing TestChangeIsJudgedByTheTermsItStartedWith). A count is raised with a reason of its own (check: internal/landing TestLandingRaisesItsOwnCount, cmd/plan TestSetCountWritesTheCountAndItsReason). Test code, fixtures, record schemas and CUDA source are reported with each landing and not refused (check: internal/landing TestLandingSaysWhatAChangeAddsOfEachKind, internal/landing TestWrittenCodeIsCountedByKind). A new export has a consumer outside its package (check: internal/landing TestExportUseCountsConsumers).

A stored result is reused only under unchanged identity of code, model, recipe, data, settings and request, and a fresh request always runs (check: internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity, internal/capabilityruntime TestFreshRunExecutesWhatAnIdenticalRequestStored, cmd/validate TestResumedRunStartsAgainACellWhoseWeightsChanged). Eligibility is kept apart from selection, observations from scores, and choosing records from confirming ones (check: internal/trainingworkflow TestSelectionNeverRestoresEligibility, internal/evaluation TestScoringFixRunsNoCaseAgain, internal/evaluation TestConfirmationIsChargedBeforeThePromotionPartIsRead).

An experiment's acceptance is frozen before it trains, from the store's cases and never from its arms (check: internal/evaluation TestInstructionAcceptanceBindsProtocolGroupsAndComparisons, internal/evaluation TestHeldOutPoolIsSizedForItsDeclaredGain, internal/trainingworkflow TestPilotAcceptanceIsFixedFromTheStoresCases). A complete negative or inconclusive record closes an experiment and activates nothing (check: internal/trainingworkflow TestRewardAdoptionRequiresDeclaredComparisons, internal/trainingworkflow TestFirstRewardRunsRecordIsComplete, cmd/train TestPilotKeepsItsRecordBeforeItRemovesItsCheckpoints).

Pinned model_index.json declares MOSSImagePipeline, MOSSImageTransformer, MOSSImageScheduler, Qwen3_5Model, Qwen2Tokenizer and AutoencoderKLFlux2.
The transformer config declares 42 layers, hidden width 3072, FFN width 8192, 24 heads, text width 4096, timestep frequency width 256 and 128 packed latent channels.
The text encoder config declares 32 hybrid linear/full-attention layers with hidden width 4096; reuse Overgo's Qwen3.5 execution where its hidden-state contract matches.
The bundled VAE has 32 latent channels, a 2-by-2 latent patch, batch-normalization statistics and the small decoder widths [96,192,384,384]; the current latentimage QwenImage VAE and selected-layer Qwen3-VL conditioner are not drop-in implementations.
Pinned SFT safetensors sizes are 16785478992 bytes for the text encoder, 10164664216 bytes for the transformer and 249521372 bytes for the VAE: 27199664580 bytes before tokenizer, metadata, runtime buffers or caches.
Only the SFT checkpoint is an acquisition, serving and evaluation target; previously collected Base metadata remains historical reference material.
Resident inference memory is unmeasured and must include activations, attention workspace, decoder buffers, graph allocations and host staging; the 5B marketing size describes the transformer rather than the complete pipeline.

Parity targets the pinned released pipeline, not an unavailable training-time fp32-master implementation.
Default workload uses a CPU generator seeded with 42, 1024-by-1024 output, 50 requested steps, guidance 3, shift 5, empty negative prompt and negative-branch skip index 22.
MOSSImageScheduler snaps shifted sigmas to the nearest training grid and removes consecutive duplicates, so actual step count must come from the resulting schedule.
The pipeline wraps prompts with apply_chat_template(add_generation_prompt=true, enable_thinking=true), runs individual unpadded encoder forwards with use_cache=false, and consumes last_hidden_state with a true-length mask.
DiT and conditioner use bf16; initial noise, prediction combination, Euler updates and VAE decoding use fp32; timestep sinusoids use fp64 before conversion and RoPE frequencies and phases use fp32.
Dimensions are positive multiples of 16 and prompt maximum length is 4096; preserve or explicitly expose upstream truncation rather than silently rewriting prompts.
Default CFG performs two transformer forwards per step; guidance 1 removes the negative branch.
Optional positive-branch SLG adds another forward and is deferred; unsupported controls must be rejected rather than silently ignored.
Deterministic import means the same pinned bytes and policy produce the same content identities, tensor mappings and recipe; it does not promise GPU bit identity across hardware or library versions.
Freeze numerical tolerance from independently measured oracle repeatability and datatype effects before comparing native outputs; do not widen it to accept a failed port.

Reuse artifact, hfhub, hfrepo, safetensors, tensorcatalog, modelartifact, modelintake, libraryintake and modelrecipe for acquisition, inventory, lifecycle and capability publication.
Extend the existing intake operation and CLI surfaces instead of adding a MOSS-only downloader, registry or serving process.
Keep architecture facts and defaults in versioned artifacts and recipes; implement missing numerical operations in the existing tensor, graph and media owners.
Generalize only where MOSS and a second real supported model demonstrate the same contract; preserve distinct conditioner, transformer, scheduler and decoder semantics.
Apply the broader Strata direction through exact dependency identities, stage-local execution, bounded residency and reuse of valid intermediate results, without inventing a parallel graph or cache framework.
Training-time gains are not an acceptance claim for this inference campaign.
Verification selectors below name acceptance work to be added by their rows; they are not claims that tests already exist or passed.
Use cmd/plan or the landing gate to execute row verifiers so missing tests and skips are rejected as vacuous evidence.
Hermetic and small-device parity belongs to the landing gate; full weight loads, quality sets and performance runs belong to the model-tagged improvement cycle.
Production syntax-node counts below are planning estimates for new behavior, not measured performance targets; narrow them when the first implementation diff establishes the required scope.

budget.reason: Estimate: the named set and its selection in cmd/validate, and the lines that say otherwise.

steps.title: Measure the owner's models, the newly trained and one per runtime path a change reaches
steps.rationale:
SelectValidation runs every other activated cell every cycle: 'nothing here asks whether its evidence still holds' (cmd/validate/selection.go:138, 'run: re-acquired every cycle' at :179), and plan paragraph 2 makes that doctrine: 'Every contract a comparison reads and every retained protocol is a cell the cycle runs'. budget.reason: Estimate, unmeasured. model-process changes how cmd/validate launches cells; hash-once passes digests between phases; answer-score splits one identity.

steps.title: Reduce the longer test runs inside a full measurement run
steps.rationale:
Measure first. The 2026-10-31 run spent 5h30m of 9h05m in the longer test runs and 3h08m measuring. cmd/validate/lane_walls.go:21-44 keeps walls of a minute or more in process state, and they never reach the run record. Record each package's wall there, with its peak working set: internal/processcontrol/supervisor_windows.go:108-109 declares PeakProcessMemoryUsed, unread, and that finds the package recorded at 49 GiB. internal/testprocess/measure.go sees only the direct child, and go test's binary is a grandchild, so the job counter is the right owner.
Move what only guards a past adoption behind pairtest, as earlier cost four tests 237 minutes. SQA-266 asks the same.
Besides the pairtest move: the models lane builds with -tags modeltest,integration, so the untagged tests a commit's test stage already ran get no cache hit (internal/landing/lanes.go:134-136,208-214, unverified); internal/inference, routedlm, latentimage, mosstrain and cmd/train run in both the cuda and the models lane (lanes.go:199-214, unverified); the audio lane runs -count=1 and is never cached (internal/landing/lanes.go:126); lanes run one after another (cmd/validate/run.go:236-239, unverified). After it lands, one full measurement run reads the pairtest move's effect.
Predicted: under 2 hours for that phase, with no cell dropped.
Serves: development velocity; more runs a week.
Disappears: repeated work.
Evidence: phase walls across two runs.
Batch: validate lane.

steps.title: Measure every cell of one model in one process
steps.rationale:
Measure first: sum one model's load walls across the 2026-10-31 run's records. Each cell is its own go run (cmd/validate/run.go:328-345), every activated cell runs every run (cmd/validate/selection.go:179), and a text model loads at least five times a run, once per benchmark, guard and serving cell (cmd/validate/run.go:56-120, unverified). Preflight repeats each cell's setup (run.go:352-387, unverified).
One process per model loads it once and runs its benchmarks and guard in turn. The serving cell keeps a fresh load of its own, since first-output and throughput are read on the first request after a load. One build, so every cell keeps the same execution identity.
Predicted: about four loads fewer per text model, before the walls are summed.
Serves: development velocity; more runs a week.
Disappears: repeated loads and builds.
Evidence: cell-phase wall across two runs.
Batch: validate lane.

steps.title: Identify each model's files once per run
steps.rationale:
bindCells hashes every consumed model file through artifact.IdentifyFile (cmd/validate/cell_credit.go:159), and its memo lives in one process. Plan, preflight, cells and fill are separate validate processes (cmd/validate/main.go:282-294, unverified), so a run hashes every model's bytes about four times.
Hash once at the run's start and hand the digests to each phase through the run's own record. Model bytes stay identified by their hash; no size and date memo.
Measure first: total model bytes and the hash rate.
Serves: development velocity.
Disappears: three full reads of every model a run.
Evidence: preflight and fill walls across two runs.
Batch: validate lane.

steps.title: Re-score stored answers when only the scoring code changed
steps.rationale:
Measure first: count the commits in 30 days that move the evaluation identity only through internal/evaluation, cmd/evaluate or internal/modelcli. Answers are keyed on an identity that adds every file of those to the code that runs the model (internal/inferencesurface/identity.go:57, internal/evaluation/campaign.go:37-48, observation.go:69-78, unverified). An agent counted 437 of 1,578 commits moving it, 230 through those packages alone (unverified).
Split it in two: the answer identity is the code that builds the request and produces the output, and the scoring identity is the code that grades it. A scoring change re-scores stored answers, which a committed verdict already does (TestCommittedVerdictRescoresItsReports). An answer is still reused only under the code that produced it, bit for bit.
Read decision carry-cost first.
Serves: development velocity; held-out cells that finish sooner.
Disappears: re-asking cases whose answers cannot have moved.
Evidence: cases re-asked against reused across two runs.

steps.title: Drop a GGUF view's built tensors when a load ends
steps.rationale:

Disappears: the kept tensors after load.

steps.rationale:
peakAcrossSessions takes the larger session's peak and says that is the high-water mark (internal/latentvideo/production_cuda_windows.go:285-305). Disappears: a false comment.

steps.title: Measure what per-tensor allocations cost, then hold a store in one
steps.rationale:
Measure first: allocate 1,024 buffers each at 16 KiB, 704 KB and 5 MB and read MemInfo's fall. Experts learned this: about 540 allocations decoded at a third of the rate and lost 500 MB (internal/modeldevice/expert_residency.go:407-409). Weights still take one a tensor (device_load.go:292, internal/graphruntime/resident.go:146), a bound of 0.86 GiB on the 4B the ledger cannot see. ResidentSession.Release frees tensor by tensor and MOSS's stages depend on it (resident.go:239-257), so a store is one allocation per program or source, not per model.
Serves: card memory for every model, experts on Flash-Next, and possibly throughput.
Disappears: per-tensor allocations.
Evidence: MemInfo before and after, three bench rounds.
Batch: device lane; opens with the first measurement's result.

Each MemAlloc also takes a cross-process transaction and reads free memory (internal/cuda/driver/driver_windows.go:659), so the measurement should time allocation as well as count bytes.

Disappears: nothing.

Disappears: nothing.

items.title: Remove repeated work from a served request and a server start

budget.reason: Estimate, unmeasured. kv-bf16 and graph-reuse change the inference surface and go before one measurement run.

steps.title: Return a response before its serving record is written
steps.rationale:
After a generation returns, the handler recompiles the recipe to read its identity (servingIdentity, internal/server/serving_observation.go:50-65, which reaches Describe's ValidateServing and CompileProgram, internal/modelrecipe/description.go:23-34) and commits a serving record under a handler-wide mutex (serving_observation.go:71; called at internal/server/server_admin.go:1093-1118) before it returns.
The identity cannot change while a model is loaded, so read it at load. Hand the record to one background writer that Close drains, so every record is still written and concurrent requests stop queuing on the mutex.
Measure first: time publishServing on the smallest served model.
Serves: inference.
Disappears: a recipe compile and a store commit on each request's path.
Evidence: request wall with and without the writer, records equal.
Batch: serving lane.

steps.title: Store the key-value cache in BF16
steps.rationale:
Cache storage is allocated as F32 (internal/inference/device_cache.go:1421,1494,2180), twice the bytes of BF16; llama.cpp's default cache type is f16. peak-by-length (5c7774a11) now reads peak device memory at 4K and 16K, so the next full run gives the earlier numbers this is judged against.
Judge it on held-out quality, as a fast native path is, and on peak device memory at 16K.
Serves: inference; peak-device-memory at long prompts.
Disappears: half the cache's bytes.
Evidence: peak at 4K and 16K, held-out cells.
Batch: one commit with the other surface moves, before one measurement run.

steps.title: Open the store once when the server starts
steps.rationale:
A server start opens the store read-only three times (cmd/server/transcription.go:22, cmd/server/main.go:251, internal/modelcli/model.go:164, the last timed as the load's store open stage) and loads the discovery memo four times (transcription.go:27, main.go:262, model.go:172, internal/server/server.go:715). time-and-memory/store-open measured an open at 2.72 s on 2026-10-13, decoding seven projections.
Pass one read-only handle and one memo through the start. The writer open (main.go:332) stays apart, since a writer open starved concurrent serves (model.go:158-160).
Serves: load-time.
Disappears: two opens and three memo loads per start.
Evidence: the load's store open stage before and after.
Batch: serving lane, with time-and-memory/store-open.

steps.title: Keep captured decode graphs by use rather than clearing them
steps.rationale:
Measure first: count captures per served request over a bench run, and retire this step if misses are rare. The decode sessions are cleared all at once when they reach 64 (internal/inference/device_cache.go:962,1111), and an executor keeps 4 captured graphs (internal/cuda/executor/executor.go:134). A miss plans memory and captures again, 13 to 60 ms (device_cache.go:961, unverified), and continuous batching never replays sequences of different lengths (device_cache.go:772, unverified). dense-read-release (8780ef3e0) now also drops a dense model's graphs after a long read, at +0.7 to 2.2 percent first output there.
Evict the least recently used session, and pad batch lengths to a few sizes so they replay.
Serves: inference; first-output and throughput.
Disappears: recaptures of graphs already built.
Evidence: captures per request before and after.
Batch: one commit with the other surface moves, before one measurement run.

steps.rationale:

Hash each block as it is read for upload. The model's bytes stay identified by their hash.
Serves: load-time on a first load.
Disappears: one full read of the model.
Evidence: load wall with no memo entry, before and after.
Batch: serving lane.

Hypothesis: one-time setup (graph capture, module load, library setup) runs on the first request for some recipes and at load for others; loading Bonsai's PTX modules at open once cut its first request from 111 to 85 ms. Compare recipe measure -journey's stages on the 0.5B and the 9B, and retire this step if they share no fixed part.

Disappears: nothing until measured.
Evidence: journey stages of both models.
Batch: serving lane.

Disappears: nothing.

steps.title: A trained model serves at its base's precision
steps.rationale:
A safetensors checkpoint saves 32-bit weights where its base holds 16-bit: 1.98 GB against 0.99 GB. The two trained models read 321 and 318 tok/s against the base's 505.7, a first token at 4096 tokens of 142 ms against 79 ms, and a load of 3.15 s against 1.6 s, with nothing in the training to explain any of it.
Save what serves at the base's precision, and keep what resumes as it is. Measure first: a 16-bit float may round away small updates, so the check is the verdict re-read on the rounded weights, and if the gain goes the row is retired with the reading.
Serves: throughput, load-time and peak-device-memory of every trained model.
Disappears: a trained model twice the size of its base.

steps.rationale:

Keep a Krea prompt's selected-layer rows on the host as MOSS keeps its hidden states, bounded the same way, and fuse a prompt met again from them, placing no encoder layer. Hold the picture to the one its prompt makes when encoded fresh, byte for byte.
Serves: first-output for image generation on a prompt met again.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: the test, and a repeated prompt's prepare time in the next stage record.
Batch: media lane.

steps.rationale:

It still needs .overgo-runtime/loop.json (:202-209) naming a worker (:210) and an exact profile strategy_id (:261), that strategy and its prompt in the store (:264-276), to publish it a spec (cmd/loop/evidence.go:27-31) naming an agent definition whose only door is the server (internal/server/agent_control.go:111,336-357) plus a catalog, a policy and a model recipe (internal/recipe/agent.go:71-75), and OVERGO_AUTOMATION_WORKER set (main.go:220, internal/processcontrol/campaign.go:57-59).
Subtract instead of adding an -init. The driver uses only the strategy's Loop (:240), Prompt (:273) and ID, and nothing reads the ID's environment value (:364-371). Put a prompt file, the two budgets and the worker name in loop.json, and take -publish-strategy out of the start. The prompt already goes by argv and stdin (:337-340,372).
ObligationWorld has no non-test implementer (internal/loop/driver.go:72-81,145,152), yet skill.md:177 cites its test. Wire it or remove both.
Serves: setup-steps, and hours of unattended work.
Disappears: the strategy record at start, OVERGO_STRATEGY and OVERGO_STRATEGY_ID, and the .cmd hand step.
Evidence: a fixture start from an empty state directory.
Batch: host lane.

steps.title: End a run that finds work waiting as waiting, not as an error
steps.rationale:
Partly repaired since filing: the driver waits on the lock (cmd/loop/main.go:290,321-323), and decisions no longer wait (internal/plan/dispatch.go:234-243). What remains is a stop, which Paused handles first, and another lane's rows (dispatch.go:246).
The live fault is after a worker exits: a dispatch found waiting there returns reason '' with 'loop: re-read plan: ...' (internal/loop/driver.go:240-243, measured), where :164-167 gives a waiting reason, and :179-181 reports plan-complete with an error. internal/loop/dispatch_wait_test.go:17 pins the current return. Wake on the plan's commit or a released lock, a signal and not a timer, as doctrine requires.
WorkerTimeoutMinutes defaulting to 90 (main.go:213-215) is a fixed timer the same doctrine refuses, and a landing can outlast it: bound by the landing's own signals.
SQA-258 and SQA-271 land here: the supervising process awaits the run through the first-start driver, so a detached launcher exit is never read as run success and a finished or failed run is acted on without a nudge. sqa-cycle/run-continuation was retired into this step, as SQA-271 directs.
Serves: unattended runtime.
Disappears: the 90-minute default.
Evidence: a world that releases a row after one wait, and a waiting plan after a worker exits.
Batch: loop lane.

items.title: Test one composite model: give Qwen3.5-9B vision through a trained bridge

budget.reason: Estimate 1,000 to 1,300: the gradient through a frozen text model is new, and the encoder-bridge route computes no gradient today.

steps.title: Freeze the comparison before any training
steps.rationale:
The experiment asks one question: does a small host encoder plus a trained projector give Qwen3.5-9B useful vision at far less card memory than a native vision model? Qwen3.5-9B peaks at 9.0 GiB, Qwen3.8-27B at 22.3 GiB.
Fix before training: the suite, the required gain, the split, the limits on card memory and first output, and a limit on GPU-hours. A full-stack 9B step took about 3 min 4 s (docs/verification/qwen35-9b-fullstack-training-run.txt:87-90), so a thousand steps is about 51 hours; Qwen2.5-0.5B took 0.47 s a step. A bounded run on 0.5B comes first, and if it shows no gain the row ends with a record.
No download is needed: VidGen clips, captions and frames should be on disk, and evaluate -build-caption-matching takes a seed and a case count (cmd/evaluate/main.go:93-97). Confirm the data is there. Held-out clips and their source videos stay out of training.
Confirm that RxBrain's 0.63 and Qwen3.8-27B's 0.92 rest on this suite (README.md:121-122,134); if not, read both on it. At 64 cases one reading's standard error is 0.061 at 0.63, so build a larger suite if the required gain is smaller than that can detect.
Include a floor (a constant answer) and a ceiling (27B).
Serves: held-out-quality and peak-device-memory.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: an acceptance record published before the first training step.
Batch: evaluation lane.

steps.title: Score the seam from measured representations
steps.rationale:
The Score function in cmd/seam-align returns the value in its input file (cmd/seam-align/main.go:228-234), so a recorded score proves nothing about the two models. The command has no test file yet.
Capture real encoder outputs and real text embeddings over the training split, then rank DINO's pooled and patch outputs and the bridge operators by alignment residual (internal/composition/alignment_residual.go:24) before GPU-hours are spent.
A residual is a cheap estimate: AlignmentResidualBiasAudit (:183) holds it to measured parity once bridges are trained.
Serves: GPU-hours go only to likely connections.
Disappears: the hand-supplied score.
Evidence: residuals from captured tensors, and a planted unrelated pair that scores badly.
Batch: host lane.

steps.title: Serve a composition through a recipe
steps.rationale:
ProductionComposition holds capture, transform and inject (internal/inference/representation_bridge.go:260-343), but no command reaches it: it is listed as prototype in internal/repoanalysis/testdata/unreached_declarations.txt (lines 68, 72, 136-145).
Reach it from a recipe, keeping capture and transform. Drop inject: it overrides every target token and refuses any other shape (:322-340), so it is not placeholder injection. The placeholder path is internal/inference/multimodal_prompt.go:32 and runner_projected.go:309, and a second path is what this row forbids. The recipe names encoder, bridge and text model by identity, and both models stay frozen.
Serves: a composite is a servable capability rather than a test object.
Disappears: inject, and its entries in the unreached list.
Evidence: a small composite answering through a recipe on the host.
Batch: serving lane.

steps.title: Train the projector through the frozen text model
steps.rationale:
This needs a new training path. The encoder-bridge route fits an affine map to a decoder's tokens, with no gradient and no text model (cmd/train/route_encoder_bridge.go:316-319), and internal/bridgetrain takes the caller's Gradients (train.go:40-43), though it does train only the bridge and proves both models unchanged.
The loss is caption tokens through the frozen text model, the row's main technical risk: a backward pass through Q8_0 weights on the device. The hybrid-stack route computes one for 9B but updates weights as it walks (docs/verification/qwen35-9b-fullstack-training-run.txt:31-33), so the frozen walk is new.
The bridge starts at zero output, so the untrained composite equals the text model alone, as internal/densecausal/graft.go:14-22 does.
Measure one step, then hold the GPU-hours the terms fixed. Smallest first: Qwen2.5-0.5B, then 9B only if 0.5B gained.
Serves: the cheapest kind of training the system can judge, since only a small adapter changes.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a fixture run, its checkpoint record and frozen-model proof.
Batch: training lanes.

steps.title: Judge the composite, then keep or remove it
steps.rationale:
Read the composite, floor and ceiling on the frozen held-out suite with exposure charged, and retain the record, which the check reads: a model-tagged test would train in every run (internal/landing/lanes.go:85-89,134). Report quality, peak card memory, throughput and first output side by side; the host encoder alone reads 4.5 s today (README.md:144), which may decide the result.
A win publishes an inactive candidate, activated through close-the-loop or by hand. A composite has no slot yet, so its activation is by hand until that row lands.
A loss keeps one record under docs/verification and removes what this row added, as the doctrine asks of a null result. A projector matching a native vision model is an open question, and a clear loss is a valid outcome.
Either result feeds the seam-align bias audit.
Serves: held-out-quality and peak-device-memory, on evidence.
Disappears: on a loss, this row's wiring.
Evidence: one retained verdict, whichever way it goes.
Batch: one device run by the row; the check is host lane.
